narration: Most mortgages hide a fee called PMI. It doesn't protect you — it covers your bank. And it costs the average homeowner fourteen hundred dollars every year.
visual: Dark background. House silhouette (triangle roof, rectangle body, door, windows) springs in center. PMI badge (red circle) floats in over the rooftop. '$1,400/YR — PROTECTS YOUR BANK NOT YOU' text appears below.

narration: PMI kicks in when your down payment is under twenty percent. Average homeowners pay it for over seven years. That's over eight thousand dollars gone forever.
visual: Light background. Seven horizontal red bars appear one by one (one per year), each labeled 'Yr 1–7 — $1,200'. Running total counter at bottom counts up to $8,400.

narration: Here's what they don't tell you — at eighty percent equity, your bank is required to remove PMI. But they wait for you to ask, not act.
visual: Dark background. LTV gauge bar animates from 95% down toward the 80% threshold. Dotted white line marks the 80% cutoff. 'PMI MUST BE REMOVED' above the line. 'YOUR BANK WAITS FOR YOU TO ASK' text below.

narration: You can force the removal. Get an appraisal showing your home's value, verify you're at eighty percent, then send one letter. One letter, thousands saved.
visual: Light background. Document SVG (paper with corner fold and text lines). Three steps appear sequentially with slide-in: 1) Get an Appraisal, 2) Verify 80% Equity, 3) Send One Letter. Bold headline above.

narration: Two neighbors bought the same house same year. One sent a letter at year three and dropped PMI. The other stayed quiet and paid eleven thousand extra.
visual: Dark background. Two small house icons side by side. Left: green border, 'NEIGHBOR — SENT LETTER YR 3 — $11K SAVED.' Right: red border, 'YOU — STAYED QUIET — $11K PAID EXTRA.'

narration: Pull up your mortgage statement right now. If your balance is near eighty percent loan-to-value, PMI should be gone. That letter takes five minutes — write it today.
visual: Light background. Smartphone SVG with dollar sign on screen. Three action bullets appear: Find Your Loan Balance, Calculate Your LTV, If Near 80% Write the Letter. Bold red 'FOLLOW FOR MORE MONEY SECRETS' CTA.
